newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell 1997 earnings outlook on target.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell 1997 earnings outlook on target.

text.p: Honeywell Inc, which reported higher first quarter earnings, said Tuesday its 1997 full-year earnings outlook is on target.
"We are on track to meet our full-year earnings outlook," Michael Bonsignore, Honeywell chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
Honeywell reported first quarter earnings of $0.60 a share versus $0.51 last year. It said total company operating margin rose 40 basis points, driven by improvement in Space and Aviation Control.
Honeywell said that division and Home and Building Control both posted strong orders, with Space and Aviation up 19 percent and Home and Building rising 10 percent.

"Our orders were strong, led by Home and Building Control and Space and Aviation Control," Bonsignore said. "We continue to implement our internal growth strategies around the world and have augmented these strategies with value-enhancing acquisitions."
In March, Honeywell completed its $600 million acquisition of Measurex Corp, which it said will play a significant role in expanding its industrial business.
Shares of Honeywell traded up one at 69-5/8.
